notes.title: Thank you.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41496102/8d406c3781467af27dc9a9b8f59601888eccbd21.png[/img]First of all, I would like to thank everyone in this community for all the support.
I really didn't think back then that this community would become so big, it's just incredible, and what's more, this community is filled with great people.

I am glad that I have entertained people, made them laugh or brought them together with this work that I created.
I can only really thank you very much, I will never forget these moments...
However, I also have something to announce, namely the end of the game.

As much as I would love to continue working on this project, and I really want to, it's just not worth it.
The problem is that the game has too many problems from the ground up (ENGINE) and I have to keep it alive, it is important to me that the experience runs without problems but fixing them is not easy in exit. 

I don't want this to come across as wrong, or as if I don't feel like working on the game to get to the point. I hope you understand.

I just have to say it again, you guys are the best, I am so glad I could make people happy with this game and I am also happy about the time we had in as an community, also big thanks to everyone who helped me with the game, this is one of the best things/times in my life ever, and I will forever remember this <3.

This game would have never been this great without you guys <3.

[h2]v2.0.0 The Final Update.[/h2]
With this Announcement also comes an last Update for the game which introduces an new Monster.

[h3]Trauma[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41496102/9f5bd9c97a94e70562d321c150d8c0024bf7c137.png[/img]
Trauma is the winner of the latest monster voting where we voted on what community creation to add in the game.

notes.content:
[h2]New Lobby Map[/h2]

[h2]Flontworld - Remastered[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41496102/4b51e050a16c791ea86140a6ed1b36fafd30c9fd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41496102/bfcb8f26fe188c06b702021dfa77194caaae97ae.png[/img]
Flontworld has gotten some massive improvements, first of all, all the obsolete map objects and logic have been replaced with up to date ones, also the ambiance, props and doors have been improved.




[h2]Hydro Rework[/h2]
Hydro's perk "[b]fluxwave[/b]" has been removed due to it not really fitting hydros playstyle and also not being used like at all by users, this ability has now been replaced with "[b]Starfish[/b]".

[h3]Starfish[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41496102/50d96f2df2b253cd9fbb03865ec2096b19f7c165.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41496102/c839516c57650bd1f50c15a9f1faec702752fd6a.png[/img][/url]
[b]Starfish [/b]can be shoot out just like [b]droplets[/b], they will stick to walls when colliding with one making them "[b]Starfish-Bouncers[/b]", [b]starfish [/b]that are sticked to walls can be used to re-direct projectiles like ([b]droplets [/b]and [b]starfish[/b]), [b]starfish [/b]will stick to players faced when they hit them and then need to be removed.

Droplets that collide with "[b]Starfish-Bouncers[/b]" will get [b]poisened[/b] and therfore can also stun Hydro himself.




[h2]New Survivor Perk[/h2]
[h3]Key Scanner[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41496102/0b7efd7b5deb52739cacaa0831fe446f751a151b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41496102/d24cbc0eb65045d1cedd92d25124ae76ad3ac6fc.png[/img][/url]
This perk will send out an scan-wave that will then notify the user when [b]keys [/b]are hit with this scan.




[h2]Door Rework[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41496102/341187ea3c95836f4776a91d6d6a9265797ffb38.png[/img]
The [b]Door's[/b] that are used on [b]Flontworld[/b] have gotten an complete rework, all doors have an state system now, every door will start with the "[b]open[/b]" state and stay this way.

when interacting with an door it will first check for players below it and if so will give an error/alarm noise from it, it will then wait for the player to move out of the way and then close.

when an door is closing it wont check for players below it anymore but still if an player should manage to move below it while its closing and hit the players head with its gate it will stun the player, emergency stop itself and reset to the opening state.

after an door has been completely opened/closed it goes into an short cooldown, players can still interact with the door and shake on the fence but it wont move the gate, after the cooldown has ended you can open/close it again.

after all keys have been delivered and its escape time all doors that are open will go into lockdown mode and if they are open will therfore be closed, but they arent like locked, you can open them again shortly after.




[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] the ability for Trevor to Repair/Pickup his Traps to re-use them.
[*] the ability for Stalker to Pickup his Sensors to re-use them.
[*] the ability for spectators to see more infos, for example when stalkers motion sensor is triggered clients that are spectating stalker will also get the ping.
[*] some new skins in the skin shop.
[/list]


[h3]Changed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Duke will get 1 ammo back for his block when one is destroyed.
[*] Keys can now only be collected when also looking at them.
[*] Keys can now only be delivered if you look at the Station.
[*] Duke will now get full stamina when done sabotage on a station.
[*] Duke's Blocks can now be destroyed, also by survivors.
[*] Dukes's Earthquake will now deal 5 damage to his blocks.
[*] Interactable Doors interaction button changed to [b][E][/b] instead of [b][LMB][/b] to counter accidental trigger.
[*] some interactions to be displayed directly on some entities relative to their world position instead of the center screen.
[/list]


[h3]FIxed[/h3]
[list]
[*] An error that could occur when an lobby with an custom map has been opened and its map was changed to an vanilla one after.
[*] some collision issues
[*] Key's shadows being visible trough the map when looking trough "plane-objects".
[*] Entities being placable behind exit doors.
[*] Trevor being stuck in his own cage when caging players.
[*] Stalker's "Pathfinder" perk not working.
[*] Duke's "[b]Block of Stone[/b]" not being placeable.
[*] Duke's Sabotage either crashing the game or permanently displaying the interaction prompt.
[*] an softlock that would occur when using stalkers drone and pressing the pause button.
[*] an softlock that would occur when selecting an monster in sandbox mode and pressing the pause button.
[*] Server browser infinite hover button sound.
[*] Menu music not applying settings.
[*] top-ui-scoreboard adding infinite entrys when for example an player respawns in sandbox or an spectator joins multiple times.
[*] Survivors being able to see Soulwalkers "[b]curse of blindness[/b]" ping
[*] some objects like the exitdoor or duke block audio effect issues.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.4.1 - Survivor Pass Update
notes.content:
[h2]Survivor Pass[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41496102/cf1f5815c40bff5597488bfd2cf571d23a9f585c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41496102/1eca3b3071248673259b46df5f946bf0d96e0b94.png[/img]
Unlock content by playing the game and gaianing xp, every 100xp you get 1 tier higher in the pass.

[b]Survivor Pass - Content[/b]
[list]
[*] 6 Free tier ( Quick Chat )
[*] 8 Free tier ( Skins )
[*] 9 Premium tier ( Skins ) 

[*] 23/50 tiers are obtainable content.
[/list]

[b]Important![/b]
[i]All items contained in the pass are limited time, once obtained you keep em forever but after the pass has ended all tiers that have not been obtained will be lost forever, you have 6 weeks from now to complete the pass. ( [b]end date : october 24, 2023[/b] ).[/i]

[h2]Survivor Pass - Premium[/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2579010/EXIT_2_Multiplayer__Survivor_Pass_Premium/]Survivor Pass - Premium | DLC Steam Page.[/url]
Free tier content can be like the name says, obtained for free by only playing.
Premium tiers on the other hand can only be obtained if you have the premium pass dlc bought.

[h1]Perk Sync[/h1]
One major improvement Is that perks of all survivors will now sync ( selected perk, icon, ammo & cooldown ).

This makes it so when spectating players you can see their perks and states, so far the system works fine and I think this is an major improvement and addition to the game.

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] The round timer should now set itself to 5 seconds if all players have their perks selected.
[*] More feedback for actions added.
[*] More visual feedback added.
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]

[b]Nerfs[/b]
[list]
[*] Duke will now make an sound when activating earthquake.
[*] Earthquake will now have an 3 second cooldown after being canceled.
[*] While invisible you cannot interact with the exit door anymore.
[/list]
[b]Buffs[/b]
[list]
[*] Earthquake will now use dynamic cooldown depending on how far you charge it.
[*] Earthquake charging speed increased by 10%
[*] Stalker's motion sensor will now ping the first survivor that is detected.
[*] Stalker's motion sensor will now increase stalkers max stamina +2.5% per detection (max +10%).
[/list]

[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] fixed door collision on mp_flontworld
[*] fixed duke's earthquake visual bug (stunned).
[*] fixed texture scaling issues when an map is loaded.
[*] some small visual fixes.
[*] some ui fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Multiplayer v1.2.2
notes.content:
[h2]Improved Cloud Saving[/h2]
Before this update all the save files would had been saved locally and then synced with the steam cloud from time to time, but this didn't allways worked for everyone, some times the whole progress could be lost.

Anyway, I re-wrote the system to now save all you're savedata directly on the steam servers which should hopefully now make it nearly impossible to loose any progress ever again.

[h2]Performance Improvement[/h2]
[i]Nerdy Talk incomming![/i]
In a nutshell, I reduced the amount of texture swaps and vertex buffers that have to be submitted to the gpu.

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Parry perk should now be fixed and work again.
[/list]

notes.title: Multiplayer v1.1.4
notes.content:
[h1]v1.1.4 Multiplayer Reloaded [/h1]

[h3]Performance Upgrade[/h3] 
Many of you sure know that the performance was indeed very bad, so I sat back the last weeks and re-wrote the code for rendering all 3D stuff which comes at the cost of an big performance increase, I also removed most if not all memory leaks.


[h3]Quick Chat shop[/h3] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41496102/ec2bca977b1dae85ce6fcde5b8f6b4e2f405a4bc.png[/img]


[h3]New Monster | Hyla[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41496102/1fa80b034680e6b5180152aef3cf4db58271c816.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41496102/5438254801c8f2a0dbe2a6f37d7d75b6e89fb82a.png[/img]
[b]Hex Mark[/b]
[i]Leave a 64 pixel wide circle on the ground where you are standing. Any survivor who walks into it is weakened for 60 seconds (they can carry 3 less max keys and 1 less key for delivering). When a hex is triggered it will remain on the ground for the rest of the game but wont affect any more survivors. Has 5 charges. Charges and cooldown is shared with Hex ritual.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41496102/ef607538aa71873ce783c8b176e3be9e33ba5709.png[/img]
[b]Hex Ritual[/b]
[i]Works exactly the same as Hex mark except when a survivor steps on it,
you become invisible for 8 seconds. Has 5 charges Charges and cooldown is shared with Hex mark.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41496102/8257e847227bc4cbd82cc823196a9c2978264f87.png[/img]
[b]Hex Portal[/b]
[i]Place down one 64 pixel wide circle on the ground where you are standing that looks identical to hex mark/ritual.
Does'nt affect survivors. Activating perk again immediately sends you below the circle and it takes 1 seconds to emerge to the surface,
gaining full stamina when finished. The circle remains on the ground but has no more purpose. Has one charge.
[/i]


[h2]New Survivor Perks[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41496102/f969de8cd313e9360bd92101bde68b236157b55b.png[/img]
[b]Cloak[/b]
[i]This perk can be used to become invisible, you cannot move while invisible, the invisibility ends automatically after 30 seconds unless canceled manually beforehand.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41496102/d5a8575010a851fc85a5d6ace0f4174fdde6907d.png[/img]
[b]Dusk Veil[/b]
[i]This perk item can be used to create a wall that you can walk through but cannot see. The wall will automatically disappear after 15 seconds.[/i]



[h2]Patch notes[/h2]

[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] added an monster queue system where players who want to be monster can enter, only players inside that queue will be choosen to be monster, except the queue is empty of course.
[*] added out of bound checks so you can't for example place items out of bounds.
[*] added an effect overlay that will show active effects on players.
[/list]

[h3]Improved[/h3]
[list]
[*] Remade the top match UI.
[*] Improved text clarity.
[*] It can now be seen on the scoreboard and/or in the spectator camera how many keys a player is carrying.
[/list]

[h3]Changed[/h3]
[list]
[*] The keys will now randomly spawn on the map.
[*] The number of keys to be collected now depends on how many players are participating in the game.
[*] Duke's earthquake is now blocked by solid objects.
[*] Duke is no longer stunned by his own earthquake.
[*] The range of dukes earthquake has been reduced by 15%.
[*] Changed the sound when Trevor places his traps.
[*] The warp pod will now change its texture after being used.

notes.title: Update v1.0.4 ( Slow Motion Fix )
notes.content:
I'm really sorry that the game came across differently than it should.
The game was programmed and tested in 120hz only, I have never tested it in 60hz.

it turned out that it was an big mistake not testing it in 60hz.
Cause it turned out that the game was running on half speed, aka "Slow Motion" for 60hz users.

I have re-written a lot of code and changed the System on how the game time works.
It should be fixed now.

The Game should now be playable how it was supposed to be played.

The 120hz Support is now removed from the game, Im not sure if it will ever come back.

If you find any bug with the new System you can report them on the Community Discord or on Steam.

Kind Regards.

tags.bug: - Cause it turned out that the game was running on half speed, aka "Slow Motion" for 60hz users.

tags.feature: - The 120hz Support is now removed from the game, Im not sure if it will ever come back.
